newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TBWA S.AFRICAN PARTNER GETS REGIONAL ROLE.
newsitem.headline: TBWA S.AFRICAN PARTNER GETS REGIONAL ROLE.

text.p: International advertising agency TBWA has given its South African affiliate Hunt Lascaris responsibility for its operations in Africa and the Middle East, agency executive Reg Lascaris said on Tuesday.

"My job is going to be to acquire, do deals with, create relationships or affiliations with, agencies in Africa, Middle East, Israel, Cyprus, Greece, Turkey," Lascaris, co- chairman of Hunt Lascaris TBWA and director of the new TBWA region, told Reuters.

"Some are in place -- for example we have affiliations with a Zimbabwe agency, a Namibian agency and an agency in Nairobi. What we want to do is take those to the next stage, buy into them," Lascaris said.
He said that in the Middle East TBWA had an affiliation agreement with Intermarkets, which it was also thinking of buying into.
"My job is going to be to expand the Africa network, to expand the Middle East network," Lascaris said. "All these countries will report to us in Johannesburg."
TBWA are majority shareholders in Hunt Lascaris TBWA.
